title: The Pear
subtitle: Seventy-five pears around the throat, gathering toward a five-carat center.

stone.origin: Natural. 75 hand-matched pear diamonds graduated around the throat with a 5-carat centre.

description: Seventy-five pear diamonds run around the throat, hand-matched and graduated so they swell steadily toward a larger pear resting at the centre. Each stone's point follows the curve of the necklace, so the whole piece reads as one directional line drawing the eye inward and down. The graduation is invisible when it works — no single step is visible, only a continuous gathering of light toward the centre stone. Made to fit the neck exactly, in eighteen-karat gold or platinum. A necklace built as a single unbroken gesture.
